en: Anyway, about Veta at the landlord's place.

en: so I can't make any for strangers.
Oh, hey, mister. You're the guy from the other day.
You want me to make you some clogs?
If you want clogs, bring me the wood.
But all the trees here belong to the landlord,
so I can't just help myself.
Clogs, you see,
you have to be as handy as I am

And mister, you'd better not go
thinking you can make them yourself.
Now, clogs
keep your feet dry even around water, you know.

and not right for folks like us.

I can make a pair for you.
Oh, but before that,
tell me your name, mister.
I'm Himmler, by the way.
Huh, you're not as friendly as I thought.
Fine. Come by again sometime.
(I never asked for it, yet how merciful of him.)
, I'll make your clogs right away.
Just wait a little longer, okay?
Hey, you, I don't know your face, but
you're actually pretty handsome.
The guys my age
have mostly run off to the city, so

around here myself, but

Hey,

en: I'm on my way to the workshop now.
Drop by any time.

I'm surprised anyone but me is out this late

that's probably just you and me.

en: Hey, you're handsome.
Here to scout the competition?
Say, the older sister at the blacksmith's,
Johanna. Do you know her?
She's got quite a temper,
so a guy like you would get flattened fast.
Trust me, it happens to me all the time.
Liza, the woman who lives next to the landlord,
do you know her?
The charm of an older woman, huh? Nice.
If only it weren't for that obnoxious little brother of hers.
And the younger sister at the blacksmith's,

you're handsome.
